6731.title: Scheduled recipients remain ineligible after completion
6731.rootCauseOneLine: Creation treats any historical automation mark or run as permanent automation provenance, so settled user-thread recipients remain blocked.
6731.proposedFix: Use validated thread provenance and running-run state instead of all retained history; preserve recursion protection and paused schedules.
6731.caveats: Plugin lifecycle reproduced twice; no desktop replay. No automatic fix because changing the recursive-creation permission/safety guard exceeds the simple-fix allowance. Reproduction test and logs are inline per report-repository policy.
